description: java-sdk/hello-world/platform-help.md's frontmatter `description` attribute reads 'A simple Java orientation intro for non-Java folk who are evaluating the Couchbase Scala SDK.' - the page is entirely about the Java SDK (its title is 'Platform Introduction' under the java-sdk product tree, and its body content orients non-Java developers to Java-specific concepts), but the description metadata names a different SDK product (Scala) that this page never otherwise mentions. Almost certainly a copy-paste artifact from an equivalent Scala SDK page's frontmatter, left unedited when the Java version was authored. Search-result snippets and AI-agent page summaries built from this attribute will describe the wrong product.
